reviews.reviewText:
MCQs conceptual (half easy/half difficult).
Short:
- 3 True/False questions.
Long:
1. Trading risk.
2. Monetary policy reaction curve.
3. Central bank as a last resort.

Paper was easy and conceptual. MCQs mostly conceptual, few formulas (Present Value, Money Multiplier), Demand/Supply and Equilibrium curve.
Short Questions:
1. Relationship between quality of money and price value (Quantity theory of money).
2. Difference between required reserves and excess reserves.
3. Define collateral funds and why banks demand it.
4. Define sovereign risk and its causes.
Long Questions:
1. Define liabilities of banks: Currency, Govt deposit account, Commercial banks deposit account.
2. Negative effect of information costs and its solutions.
